description: §17.1.1 — `if=` and `else` on the SAME element fire E-CTRL-005. The `<program>` + `let <x/>` twin of ctrl-005-else-and-if-same-element-pos (a `<session { … }` state-opener shape the bootstrap does not parse), so the bootstrap grades it. Severity (Error) is pinned by that legacy-shape twin; it is not asserted here because a bootstrap Diag carries no §34 severity yet.
rationale: §17.1.1 Normative Rules: "`else` and `else-if=` SHALL NOT appear on the same element as `if=`. A single element cannot simultaneously open and continue a chain. The compiler SHALL reject such usage (E-CTRL-005)."
